change: Reuse the resource-limit byte count during admission buffer reservation; preserve rejection order and lazy sizing for buffer-only duplicates.

mdnLifecycleDifferences: Current engine uses the legacy save-path hook adapter.
Current engine imports the direct single-thread entry.
snapshots.layout: Both snapshots use per-package symlinks. Shared runtime dependencies resolve to common physical packages; baseline retains Got 13 and p-queue 8.

runs: Fresh measurements only; no pooling with historical timing reports.

suites.method: Fresh process per variant per round, including MDN. Rotate/reverse order: each variant occupies each position twice. One process median contributes per case per round.
suites.noiseRule: Four-million-iteration CPU probes bracket timed work. Five warm-ups and nine calibrations set a 1.5x median threshold before comparisons. Reject the entire three-variant group for any measured probe above threshold. Require four qualifying groups. No filtering by candidate result.
suites.timingScope: Queue admission only, with initialization, resource construction and disposal outside timing. Each observation admits 128 resources referencing one 256 KiB body, with both limits, one limit, no limit, and already-admitted duplicate cases.
